notes: Statement change, equivalent: the hypotheses `Submodule.IsLattice K L` inside the Prop definitions MajDual, HeightBasic and MajLattice become `Submodule.IsFullLattice K L`. The module compiles unchanged, but Mathlib #44365 renamed the pinned `IsLattice` (finitely generated and spanning) to `IsFullLattice` and reused the name `IsLattice` for a weaker notion without `span_eq_top`, so the unchanged text would silently weaken these definitions; the reused-name audit flagged all three. In each, L is a submodule over `𝓞 K` for a number field `K`, the fraction field of `𝓞 K`, so `IsFullLattice K L ↔ L.FG ∧ span K L = ⊤`, which is the pinned definition, because `Submodule.IsLattice.of_fg` supplies the new field. No hypothesis is added or removed.
